name: soft-door-box
task: Open the door, then, if possible, pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Open the door' commands door_open, so Existence(door_open) is hard; the 'then' order stays hard as Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up); 'if possible' scopes only 'pick up the box', so Existence(target_picked_up) is soft. Since the soft Existence forces nothing, door_open keeps its own hard Existence — the clause set matches the task exactly.
